title: HB3195 (2026 Regular Session): Requires that all sales or transfers of firearms be processed through a licensed firearms dealer

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text:
Section 571.202 (RSMo): 1. No person shall sell or otherwise transfer a firearm, including through online interactions, unless: (1) Such person is a licensed dealer; (2) The purchaser or transferee is a licensed dealer; or (3) The sale or transfer satisfies the requirements of subsection 2 or 3 of this section.
Section 571.202 (RSMo): 2. If neither party to a firearms transaction is a licensed dealer, the parties may have a licensed dealer facilitate the sale or transfer. A licensed dealer shall process the sale or other transfer as if the licensed dealer is the seller or transferor. The licensed dealer shall conduct a background check on the purchaser or transferee in accordance with 18 U.S.C. Section 922(t) and other state and local law and, if the transaction is not prohibited, deliver the firearm to the purchaser or transferee after all legal requirements are satisfied.
Section 571.202 (RSMo): 3. A trustee, under the authority of a trust, or a personal representative, executor, or administrator of an estate shall, before transferring any firearm to an heir or devisee, have a licensed dealer facilitate the sale or transfer through the process described under subsection 2 of this section.
Section 571.202 (RSMo): 5. The provisions of subsections 1 and 2 of this section shall not apply to: (5) A person who transfers a firearm to a relative who is related within the first degree by consanguinity or affinity.
Section 571.202 (RSMo): 6. A violation of a provision of this section is a class B misdemeanor. Each day a violation of this section is committed or continued shall be considered a separate violation and punished accordingly.
higher_law_duty: Dealer must run the check in accordance with 18 U.S.C. Section 922(t) (federal statute).
